6447.title: Loading-dependent wrapping in the automation mode row
6447.rootCauseOneLine: The count appears only after loading, increasing tab width beyond the wrapping row's 370px budget at a 402px viewport.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — directionally consistent; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: Pending-count reservation and a compact create label target the cause; the diff does not add the loading-transition geometry regression.

6447.proposedFix: Reserve pending count space and compact the create label at narrow widths while keeping its accessible name; add the demonstrated geometry regression to the existing linked PR.
6447.caveats: Reproduced twice using the real view in touch-emulated Chromium, not on iOS Safari. Repro script, fixture, and exact failure are inline per the report repository's publication policy. Existing PR #6446 already closes the issue, so no duplicate fix PR was opened.
